public.title: Immutability Utilities
public.description: input {value,operations}; value is an object. Operations are {op:"set",path,value} or {op:"delete",path}, with nonempty string-key paths, existing object ancestors, and arbitrary JSON set values. Apply nested immutable edits in order. Return {original,updated}; preserve original structurally. Delete of a missing final key is a no-op. This path-spec adapter models nested immutable updates; structural sharing is unobservable in JSON. Supported inputs are valid for this contract. Aggregate JSON-serialized input is at most 512 UTF-8 bytes, nesting depth at most 6, arrays at most 40 items, operation/call lists at most 20 items, and individual strings at most 100 ASCII characters unless a tighter bound is stated. Integers have absolute value at most 1000; output arithmetic stays within safe integers. String object keys and string path segments are nonempty safe alphanumeric/underscore names excluding __proto__, constructor and prototype. Empty arrays/objects are allowed where consistent with the contract. Output ordering follows the rules above. These bounds include all nested payloads and all operations together.
hints: Separate the documented JSON representation from the behavior being modeled.
Preserve ordering and distinguish missing values, null, zero and false carefully.

explanation: Deep-copy the value then resolve each nested edit path. O(input plus operation payloads and total path lengths) time and space; identity sharing cannot be tested through this contract. Functional tests check the documented adapter behavior; they do not enforce implementation technique or prohibit built-in APIs.
